lines.en: label ayanespecial1:
: Hey.
: What’s up?
lines.zh: : 怎么了？

lines.en: : Oh, you know. Just...Ayane stuff.
lines.zh: : 哦，你知道的。就……Ayane 那些事。

lines.en: : Are you...busy right now?
lines.zh: : 你……现在忙吗？

lines.en: : I’m just watching Tsuneyo cook.
lines.zh: : 我正看着 Tsuneyo 做饭。

lines.en: : Huh? Are you all the way in the old district right now?
lines.zh: : 哈？你现在大老远在老城区？

lines.en: : Nope. I’m at my house- where {i}you{/i} would also be if you weren’t using your “secret girl powers” again.
lines.zh: : 没有。我在我家——你要是没又在用你那「少女超能力」的话，{i}你{/i}本来也该在这儿。

lines.en: : Oooooh...
lines.zh: : 哦哦哦……

lines.en: : Yeah.
: Yeah, I’m feeling fine.
lines.zh: : 对，我没事。

lines.en: : But...I was actually wondering if you’d want to come meet up for a little while.
lines.zh: : 不过……我其实在想，你要不要出来见一会儿。

lines.en: : So you don’t want to come here, but you want me to come to you?
lines.zh: : 所以你不想过来，但要我过去找你？

lines.en: : Right.
: Am I a delivery service now?
lines.zh: : 我现在成外卖服务了？

lines.en: : Hahah...maybe.
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈……也许吧。

lines.en: : It really is only for a little while, though.
lines.zh: : 不过真的只要一小会儿。

lines.en: I sigh to myself and look over at Tsuneyo, who isn’t paying any attention to me at all.
lines.zh: 我暗自叹了口气，看向 Tsuneyo——她压根没在注意我。

lines.en: I doubt I could get away from the house without things looking suspicious, but...
lines.zh: 我怀疑我没法在不引起怀疑的情况下溜出这屋子，不过……

lines.en: It isn’t often that Ayane actually asks me to come meet up with her in the middle of the night.
lines.zh: Ayane 主动叫我半夜出去见她，这可不常有。

lines.en: : Are you at your dorm?
lines.zh: : 你在宿舍吗？

lines.en: : Nope.
lines.zh: : 没有。

lines.en: : I’m at[school].
lines.zh: : 我在[school]。

lines.en: : What? Why?
lines.zh: : 什么？为什么？

lines.en: : Hahah...
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈……

lines.en: : That’s the weird part.
lines.zh: : 这就是怪的地方。

lines.en: : I don’t really know.
lines.zh: : 我也真不知道。

lines.en: : I just got this urge to come here all of a sudden.
lines.zh: : 我就是突然有种冲动想来这儿。

lines.en: : Well that’s not suspicious at all.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那一点都不可疑。

lines.en: : I’ll start heading over now.
lines.zh: : 我现在就动身过去。

lines.en: : Thanks...
lines.zh: : 谢谢……

lines.en: : It really shouldn’t take long. Just tell Ami that you’re running out to buy them snacks or something and I’m sure everything will be okay.
lines.zh: : 应该不会很久。跟 Ami 说你出去给她们买零食什么的，我确信一切都会没事的。

lines.en: : I kind of already botched that idea earlier by telling them to eat whatever's in the house.
lines.zh: : 我早些时候已经把这招搞砸了——我跟她们说想吃屋里什么就吃什么。

lines.en: : I’ll think of something, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我会想出办法的。

lines.en: : Okay...
: I’ll be on the roof when you get here.
lines.zh: : 你到了之后我在屋顶。

lines.en: : The roof? Why?
lines.zh: : 屋顶？为什么？

lines.en: : The sky is all...pretty again.
lines.zh: : 天空又……变得好看了。

lines.en: : You’ll see when you get here...hahah.
lines.zh: : 你到了就知道了……哈哈。

lines.en: Each time Ayane laughs, it feels as if she’s punctuating a sentence that she’s either resistant to utter or just doesn’t want to bother with at all.
lines.zh: Ayane 每次笑，都像是在给一句她不愿说出口、或者根本懒得费心去说的句子打标点。

lines.en: It’s a strange type of laugh- nothing like the bright and jovial giggles I’ve grown accustomed to hearing from her.
lines.zh: 那是一种奇怪的笑——跟我听惯的她那种明亮、快活的咯咯笑完全不同。

lines.en: It means she’s hiding something again.
lines.zh: 那意味着她又在藏着什么。

lines.en: I don’t want to make things sound like I’m some sort of magician who can just tell how people are feeling at all times-
lines.zh: 我不想把这说得像我是那种随时能读出别人心情的魔术师——

lines.en: But it doesn’t require a magician to discern the most obvious of verbal tics.
lines.zh: 但要分辨最明显的语言小动作，并不需要魔术师。

lines.en: I heard somewhere that tics can be treated with medication, though.
lines.zh: 我听说抽动症可以用药治。

lines.en: So I utilize and accept my newfound role as the sole proprietor of Kumon-mi’s latest delivery service and offer up myself to her.
lines.zh: 于是我接受并启用自己的新身份——Kumon-mi 最新外卖服务的唯一经营者——把自己献给她。

lines.en: She will be fixed in no time at all.
lines.zh: 她很快就会被修好的。

lines.en: : Okay.
: I’ll see you soon.
lines.zh: : 一会儿见。

lines.en: : I love you.
lines.zh: : 我爱你。

lines.en: One of us hangs up.
lines.zh: 我们其中一个挂了电话。

lines.en: : Tsuneyo-
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo——

lines.en: : Go.
lines.zh: : 去吧。

lines.en: : I will inform the Emerald Guardian and the others of your absence.
lines.zh: : 我会向「翡翠卫士」和其他人通报你不在。

lines.en: : Dinner will be on the stove when and if you return.
lines.zh: : 你要是回来的话，晚饭会在炉子上。

lines.en: : If?
lines.zh: : 要是？

lines.en: : Tragedy could strike at any moment. You must always be prepared.
lines.zh: : 悲剧随时可能降临。你必须时刻做好准备。

lines.en: : ...Right.
: Anyway, I guess I’ll see you later.
lines.zh: : 总之，我回头见了。

lines.en: : Perhaps.
lines.zh: : 也许吧。

lines.en: : Goodnight, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 晚安，老师。

lines.en: scene clearnightsky
I attempt to look up at the clouds once I make my way outside but see nothing at all.
lines.zh: 出门后我试图抬头看云，却什么也没看见。

lines.en: Nothing apart from a few stray nebulas and the remnants of dead celestial bodies drifting haplessly through the air.
lines.zh: 除了一小片散落的星云、和几具死去的天体残骸在空中无助地漂着之外，什么都没有。

lines.en: I, too, drift haplessly through the air.
lines.zh: 我也同样无助地在空中漂着。

lines.en: I float through the streets of Kumon-mi, tapping my fingers against glass boxes encasing the bulbs of streetlights as if I were tapping extensions of a ceiling in the halls of an old[school].
lines.zh: 我飘过 Kumon-mi 的街道，手指敲过罩住路灯灯泡的玻璃罩，就像在敲某所老[school]走廊天花板的延伸部分。

lines.en: A[school] I would have attended before my (?)  body had grown to its current size.
lines.zh: 一所在我这具（？）身体长到现在这么大之前本该去上的[school]。

lines.en: A[school] where I would have learned who I am or what I am or where I am or how I am.
lines.zh: 一所我本该在那儿学会我是谁、我是什么、我在哪儿、我怎么样的[school]。

lines.en: A[school].
lines.zh: 一所[school]。

lines.en: School.
lines.zh: 学校。

lines.en: That is where I’m heading.
lines.zh: 那就是我要去的地方。

lines.en: I need to remind myself, as being this close to the sky is somehow distracting me from the order at hand here.
lines.zh: 我得提醒自己——因为离天这么近，不知怎么让我分了心，忘了眼下的正事。

lines.en: To meet with a girl who needs to see me now more than ever.
lines.zh: 去见一个现在比以往任何时候都更需要见到我的女孩。

lines.en: I wonder if we will have sex.
lines.zh: 我猜我们会做爱。

lines.en: I hope that we will have sex.
lines.zh: 我希望我们会做爱。

lines.en: I am happy when I have sex.
lines.zh: 我做爱的时候是幸福的。

lines.en: scene black
I close my eyes and allow my metaphorical wings to carry me the rest of the way.
lines.zh: 我闭上眼，让我那比喻意义上的翅膀带我走完剩下的路。

lines.en: What I mean by this is that I’ve walked the path so many times now that I don’t even need vision in order to make it there.
lines.zh: 我的意思是：这条路我走过太多次了，连看都不用看就能走到。

lines.en: Or at least that’s what I think until I walk face first into a dumpster.
lines.zh: 或者至少在我一头撞上一个垃圾箱之前，我是这么想的。

lines.en: From that point onward, I keep my eyes open-
lines.zh: 从那以后，我就一直睁着眼——

lines.en: Proving once and for all that you can never see more with them closed.
lines.zh: 一举证明：闭着眼睛永远看不到更多。

lines.en: scene nevermind1
Ayane Amamiya\nOccupation: Happy girl\nVaginal Depth: Medium-Shallow
lines.zh:
天雨 Ayane
职业：快乐的女孩
阴道深度：中偏浅

lines.en: She sits on a bench with a scarf wrapped around her that she had to purchase for herself because a man whom she would give her life for bought her friends one instead of her.
lines.zh: 她坐在长椅上，围着一条自己掏钱买的围巾——因为她愿意为之付出生命的那个男人，给她的朋友们买了围巾，却没给她买。

lines.en: All she wanted was to match.
lines.zh: 她想要的只是能跟她们一样。

lines.en: Some nights, she lays awake in bed, pondering over things those friends may have said to him while she was not around.
lines.zh: 有些夜里，她躺在床上睡不着，琢磨着她不在的时候，那些朋友可能对他讲了什么。

lines.en: She worries that both of them are more compatible with him than she is.
lines.zh: 她担心她们俩都比她更合他。

lines.en: She worries the same thing for virtually everyone else that she encounters, for sometimes simply hearing that the person you love loves you back is not enough to convince you.
lines.zh: 她对遇到的几乎每个人都担心同样的事——因为有时候，光是听见你爱的人说他也爱你，并不足以让你信服。

lines.en: She claims to have the blood of a warrior, but she is really just O-.
lines.zh: 她自称流着战士的血，可她其实只是 O 型。

lines.en: Giving to everyone, receiving from no one. And destined to lurk somewhere in the background until it is her time to shine.
lines.zh: 给所有人，不取任何人。注定要潜伏在背景里，直到轮到她发光的那一刻。

lines.en: Occasionally, she will glance up at the sky, wondering how much longer it will take for her “future husband” to arrive.
lines.zh: 偶尔，她会抬眼望天，想知道她的「未来丈夫」还要多久才到。

lines.en: Unbeknownst to her, he is floating through the streets below, colliding with trash receptacles and attempting to catch birds.
lines.zh: 她不知道的是，他正在下面的街道上漂着，撞着垃圾桶、试图抓鸟。

lines.en: He catches none, but several land beside her as she waits.
lines.zh: 他一只也没抓到，但有几只落在了等待中的她身边。

lines.en: And waits.
lines.zh: 然后等着。

lines.en: And waits.
lines.zh: 再等着。

lines.en: All the while, it grows.
lines.zh: 而自始至终，它在变大。

lines.en: scene black
I eventually arrive at the[school] and glance down at my phone to discover that it’s taken me relatively longer than normal to make it here.
lines.zh: 我最终到了[school]，低头看手机，发现这次花的时间比平时长了不少。

lines.en: I have several missed messages from Ayane, but see no purpose in responding to any of them as I’ll be seeing her any minute now.
lines.zh: 我有几条 Ayane 的未读消息，但觉得没必要回——反正马上就能见到她了。

lines.en: I spread my arms out and part the[school] gates like Moses parting the Red Sea.
lines.zh: 我张开双臂，像摩西分开红海那样分开[school]的大门。

lines.en: It’s incredibly effective because the gates were actually left open, and it enables me to feel much more important than I actually am for a brief moment in time.
lines.zh: 这招出奇地有效，因为门其实本来就开着——而它让我在短短一瞬间里，觉得自己比实际上重要得多。

lines.en: I move through the[school].
lines.zh: 我穿过[school]。

lines.en: I make it to the roof.
lines.zh: 我上了屋顶。

lines.en: I open the door.
lines.zh: 我推开门。

lines.en: scene nevermind2
: Oh, good...I was starting to worry that maybe you were...abducted or kidnapped or something.
lines.zh: : 哦，太好了……我正开始担心你是不是……被拐走、被绑架什么的。

lines.en: : I don’t really think it would count as “kidnapping” if someone my age was taken, so abducted works fine here.
lines.zh: : 我觉得要是我这个年纪的人被带走，大概算不上「拐卖」，所以「绑架」在这儿更合适。

lines.en: scene nevermind3
: Right, yeah. I should have just followed my gut.
lines.zh: : 对，也是。我该跟着直觉走。

lines.en: : So, you really weren’t joking about the sky.
lines.zh: : 所以，关于天空你真没开玩笑。

lines.en: : Crazy, right? It’s been like this pretty much every night lately.
lines.zh: : 疯了吧？最近几乎每晚都这样。

lines.en: : Do you know if this means anything for the weather? Like, is winter going to end early or something?
lines.zh: : 你知道这对天气意味着什么吗？比如冬天会不会提前结束什么的？

lines.en: : Nah. The world is just coming to an end.
lines.zh: : 不。只是世界要完蛋了。

lines.en: scene nevermind4
: Well, if that is the case, I’m glad that I get to share my final moments with you.
lines.zh: : 嗯，如果是那样，我很高兴能跟你一起度过最后的时刻。

lines.en: : If you’d have actually come to the slumber party thing, we could have all weathered the apocalypse together.
lines.zh: : 你要是真来参加那个睡衣派对，我们本来可以一起熬过末日的。

lines.en: : But, Sensei, I don’t want to be around anyone else right now.
lines.zh: : 可是，老师，我现在不想跟别的任何人待在一起。

lines.en: : I wanted to lure you all the way over here so I could adultnap you and hide you in a secret passage underneath my house and be together forever.
lines.zh: : 我想把你一路诱到这儿，然后「成人绑架」你，把你藏在我家底下的秘密通道里，永远在一起。

lines.en: : Okay, well, this has been fun. But I’ve got to head out.
lines.zh: : 好，行，挺开心的。不过我得走了。

lines.en: scene nevermind5
: Oh, stop. You know I’m only kidding.
lines.zh: : 哦，得了吧。你知道我开玩笑的。

lines.en: : If that were ever going to happen, I’d abduct Ami, Maya, and Sana too so all of us could live happily ever after in my secret underground bunker.
lines.zh: : 要是真有那么一天，我会把 Ami、Maya 和 Sana 也一起绑来，好让我们全都在我那秘密地下掩体里幸福地生活下去。

lines.en: : Sounds to me like it would get pretty cramped in there rather quickly.
lines.zh: : 听起来那儿很快就会挤得要命。

lines.en: scene nevermind6
: Probably, yeah...
lines.zh: : 大概吧，是……

lines.en: : And that would make it kinda hard to have “private time” together, so...maybe I’ll have to have Geoffrey construct additional bunkers or something like that?
lines.zh: : 而且那样会很难有「私人时间」，所以……也许我得让 Geoffrey 再建几座掩体什么的？

lines.en: : Ayane.
lines.zh: : Ayane。

lines.en: scene nevermind3
: Yeah?
lines.zh: : 怎么？

lines.en: : You didn’t invite me here for construction tips, did you?
lines.zh: : 你叫我过来不是为了听装修建议吧？

lines.en: : I did not.
lines.zh: : 不是。

lines.en: : Then what’s going on?
lines.zh: : 那到底怎么回事？

lines.en: : This isn’t like you.
lines.zh: : 这不像你。

lines.en: : I’m a [teenage]girl, Sensei. My body is changing. And along with it, my interests, desires, and even my personality.
lines.zh: : 我是个[teenage]女孩啊，老师。我的身体在变化。随之而来的，还有我的兴趣、欲望、甚至性格。

lines.en: : I find that hard to believe.
lines.zh: : 这我很难相信。

lines.en: : How come?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: : Because a good chunk of your personality is rooted in how much you love me.
lines.zh: : 因为你性格里很大一部分，扎根于你有多爱我。

lines.en: : I can promise you that at least that much will never change.
lines.zh: : 我可以向你保证，至少那一点永远不会变。

lines.en: : I don’t want any of you to change, though.
lines.zh: : 可我不想让你们任何人改变。

lines.en: scene nevermind7
: Huh?
: Why is it surprising that I preferred the version of you that wasn’t using excuses to get out of everything?
lines.zh: : 我更喜欢那个不会找借口逃避一切的你，这有什么好惊讶的？

lines.en: : It’s not! I just...
lines.zh: : 不是！只是……

lines.en: : My heart skips a beat every time you look at me and say something like that.
lines.zh: : 每次你看着我说出那种话，我的心都会漏跳一拍。

lines.en: : So hearing it will probably always make me gasp.
lines.zh: : 所以听到它大概永远都会让我倒吸一口气。

lines.en: scene nevermind3
: I hope that’s okay.
lines.zh: : 我希望那没问题。

lines.en: : It’s fine.
lines.zh: : 没问题。

lines.en: : Now, tell me what this is really all about.
lines.zh: : 现在，告诉我这到底是为了什么。

lines.en: : Aww, come on. Can’t I use stall tactics a little more before we start getting to the serious stuff?
lines.zh: : 哎呀，拜托。在进入正题之前，我就不能再用点拖延战术吗？

lines.en: : Nope. I {s}flew{/s} walked all the way here for you and I expect there to be some actual substance tonight.
lines.zh: : 不能。我{s}飞{/s}——走着——大老远来这儿找你，我指望今晚能有点实在的东西。

lines.en: scene nevermind8
: Even if it’s something you really don’t want to hear?
lines.zh: : 哪怕是你真的不想听的东西？

lines.en: : If you pull the pregnancy trick on me again, I swear-
lines.zh: : 你要是再拿怀孕那招耍我，我发誓——

lines.en: : Are you really that afraid of becoming a daddy?
lines.zh: : 你真那么怕当爸爸？

lines.en: : Yes. Now tell me what this is really about.
lines.zh: : 是的。现在告诉我这到底是为了什么。

lines.en: I want to say something about how the wind assaults us on the rooftop-
lines.zh: 我本想说点什么，说风在屋顶上袭击我们——

lines.en: But it feels as if we’re already in space.
lines.zh: 可感觉我们已经在太空里了。

lines.en: There is no wind anywhere.
lines.zh: 哪儿都没有风。

lines.en: There is no sound anywhere.
lines.zh: 哪儿都没有声音。

lines.en: There is nothing.
lines.zh: 什么都没有。

lines.en: : Can I have a hug?
lines.zh: : 能抱我一下吗？

lines.en: : You made me walk all the way over here for a hug?
lines.zh: : 你让我大老远走过来就为个拥抱？

lines.en: : Do you have any idea how much I love your hugs?
lines.zh: : 你知道我有多爱你的拥抱吗？

lines.en: : Ugh, fine. Come here.
lines.zh: : 呃，行。过来吧。

lines.en: scene nevermind9
: Heheh~ Yes, [ayanemaster].
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿～好的，[ayanemaster]。

lines.en: scene black
I’ve noticed something about Ayane over the time we’ve spent together in this strange excuse for a world.
lines.zh: 在我们共度的这段时间里，我注意到 Ayane 的某一点。

lines.en: Nearly every time she wraps her arms around me, there’s always an extravagant build-up first.
lines.zh: 几乎每次她把我搂住之前，总会有一段夸张的铺垫。

lines.en: Kind of like a dog who is obedient enough to stay off of the couch until invited onto it-
lines.zh: 有点像一只够听话的狗，在被邀请之前绝不上沙发——

lines.en: But once it is, it leaps nearly ten feet in the air and crashes into the cushions with more vigor than a male rabbit during mating season.
lines.zh: 可一旦被邀请，它能蹿起将近十英尺高，带着比交配季节的公兔还足的劲头砸进靠垫里。

lines.en: I guess dogs can’t exactly jump ten feet, though.
lines.zh: 不过我想狗大概跳不了十英尺。

lines.en: That sounds more like a demon.
lines.zh: 那听起来更像个恶魔。

lines.en: Either way, there’s no vigor at all in tonight’s embrace.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，今晚这个拥抱里一点劲头都没有。

lines.en: It’s more like wrapping my arms around a dying family pet that I’ll never get to hold again.
lines.zh: 更像是搂住一只垂死的家养宠物——一只我再也没机会抱到的宠物。

lines.en: Its legs are shaking as it struggles to even stand up.
lines.zh: 它的腿在抖，连站起来都费劲。

lines.en: They snap- and all of the weight is forced onto me.
lines.zh: 它们断了——于是所有重量都压在了我身上。

lines.en: Everything always comes back to me.
lines.zh: 一切总是回到我这儿。

lines.en: I can’t stretch my arms around all of it.
lines.zh: 我的手臂没法把这一切都圈住。

lines.en: scene nevermind10
: You’re warm.
lines.zh: : 你好暖。

lines.en: : This is what you missed out on that night we went to the park with Sana.
lines.zh: : 这就是我们跟 Sana 去公园那晚你错过的东西。

lines.en: : That was really hard, you know?
lines.zh: : 那次真的很难熬，你知道吗？

lines.en: : If it were up to me, we’d be like this every hour of every day.
lines.zh: : 要是依我，我们每时每刻都该是这样。

lines.en: : That would make it very hard to perform necessary daily functions.
lines.zh: : 那样会很难完成必要的日常功能。

lines.en: scene nevermind11
: But you wouldn’t have to jerk off anymore.
lines.zh: : 不过你就不用再打飞机了。

lines.en: : Also true.
lines.zh: : 也是实话。

lines.en: : I guess there are pros and cons to everything.
lines.zh: : 我想凡事都有利有弊。

lines.en: : I saw you once, you know.
lines.zh: : 我见过你一次，你知道吧。

lines.en: : Saw me what?
lines.zh: : 见过我什么？

lines.en: : Jerking off.
lines.zh: : 打飞机。

lines.en: : What? When?
lines.zh: : 什么？什么时候？

lines.en: : A really long time ago.
lines.zh: : 很久很久以前。

lines.en: : Ami and I both saw it because we went to your room to see if you’d make us a snack and then...surprise. Penis.
lines.zh: : 我和 Ami 都看见了，因为我们去你房间想让你给我们做点零食，然后……惊喜。阴茎。

lines.en: : Was that before or after I apparently caught you two kissing one another?
lines.zh: : 那是在我「撞见」你俩接吻之前还是之后？

lines.en: scene nevermind12
: That...
: That never actually...happened.
lines.zh: : 那其实根本没……发生过。

lines.en: : Well, apart from the Christmas party. But I was kinda just scrambling to keep things under wraps there and...
lines.zh: : 好吧，除了圣诞派对那次。不过那次我基本上是手忙脚乱地想把事情瞒住，然后……

lines.en: : You made that up?
lines.zh: : 你是编出来的？

lines.en: scene nevermind13
: Yeah.
: Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: : You know...
lines.zh: : 你知道……

lines.en: : I’ve been getting the feeling lately that you’re kind of just...going along with a lot of stuff.
lines.zh: : 我最近有种感觉，觉得你有点……只是在顺着很多事情走。

lines.en: : Like there’s part of you that’s just not really...there anymore.
lines.zh: : 像是你的某一部分……其实已经不太在了。

lines.en: : And I’ve heard you joking about your memories in the past, but like...then I started wondering if it really {i}was{/i} a joke.
lines.zh: : 我以前听你拿自己的记忆开玩笑，可是……后来我开始怀疑那到底{i}是不是{/i}玩笑。

lines.en: : What if parts of your memories really {i}were{/i} gone and...weren’t coming back?
lines.zh: : 如果你的部分记忆真的{i}没了{/i}……而且回不来了呢？

lines.en: : What would that mean for me?
lines.zh: : 那对我意味着什么？

lines.en: : When did the new memories start being recorded?
lines.zh: : 新的记忆是从什么时候开始录的？

lines.en: : Was it after I’d already fallen in love with you?
lines.zh: : 是在我爱上你之后吗？

lines.en: : And if so, how would that make me look?
lines.zh: : 如果是，那会让我看起来像什么？

lines.en: : Needy?
lines.zh: : 黏人？

lines.en: : Desperate?
lines.zh: : 绝望？

lines.en: : Naive?
lines.zh: : 天真？

lines.en: scene nevermind14
: So...yeah...
: I thought that maybe...if I could catch you going along with things that didn’t really happen...I’d know for sure.
lines.zh: : 我想……如果我能抓到你在顺着一些根本没发生过的事走……我就能确定。

lines.en: : Ayane-
lines.zh: : Ayane——

lines.en: : It’s okay that you’re hiding things from me. I don’t need to know about them.
lines.zh: : 你瞒着我一些事没关系。我不需要知道。

lines.en: : I just wanted to know how much of what we have is real and...how much I may have lost.
lines.zh: : 我只是想知道，我们之间有多少是真的……以及我可能已经失去了多少。

lines.en: : You haven’t {i}lost{/i} anything.
lines.zh: : 你什么都没{i}失去{/i}。

lines.en: : Everything that’s happened since the moment we became...intimate has been all me.
lines.zh: : 从我们变得……亲密那一刻起发生的一切，全都是我。

lines.en: scene nevermind15
: Right, but...
lines.zh: : 对，可是……

lines.en: : What about the moments that led us there?
lines.zh: : 那把我们带到那一步的那些时刻呢？

lines.en: : All of the...horrible feelings I felt...and all of the good things that came from meeting you and Ami...
lines.zh: : 所有那些……我感受到的糟糕情绪……以及遇见你和 Ami 之后来的所有好事……

lines.en: : They’ll come back.
lines.zh: : 它们会回来的。

lines.en: Maybe.
lines.zh: 也许吧。

lines.en: : And if they don’t?
lines.zh: : 要是回不来呢？

lines.en: : If they don’t, they don’t.
lines.zh: : 回不来就回不来。

lines.en: : There’s nothing we can do about it.
lines.zh: : 我们对此无能为力。

lines.en: : But I’m here now, so just focus on that.
lines.zh: : 可我现在在这儿，就专注在这上面吧。

lines.en: scene nevermind16
: Okay.
: There’s still...a lot more I want to talk about, though.
lines.zh: : 不过……我还想聊的还有很多。

lines.en: : Well, I don’t {i}want{/i} to talk about it, but I kind of have to if things are ever going to change.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我不{i}想{/i}聊，但如果事情真要有改变，我就不得不聊。

lines.en: : Why do they have to change?
lines.zh: : 为什么非得改变？

lines.en: : Everything has to change. That’s how the world works.
lines.zh: : 一切都得改变。世界就是这么运转的。

lines.en: : Change is so exhausting, though...
lines.zh: : 可改变太累了……

lines.en: scene nevermind17
: I know it is...I agree...
lines.zh: : 我知道……我同意……

lines.en: : But...there is one change we kind of...have to acknowledge...
lines.zh: : 可是……有一个变化我们大概……得承认……

lines.en: : And what is that?
lines.zh: : 那是什么？

lines.en: : Sensei...
lines.zh: : 老师……

lines.en: : You know that Ami is...actually in love with you, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道 Ami 其实爱上你了，对吧？

lines.en: : Like, not just as a [niece]. As a girl.
lines.zh: : 就是说，不只是作为[niece]。作为一个女孩。

lines.en: : I...don’t even know why I’m asking. Of course you know. It would be impossible not to.
lines.zh: : 我……都不知道我为什么在问。你当然知道。不可能不知道。

lines.en: : But, like...Ami is my best friend.
lines.zh: : 可是，Ami 是我最好的朋友。

lines.en: : And...I also love you...
lines.zh: : 而且……我也爱你……

lines.en: : And I’m fine with keeping that hidden from everyone else, but...
lines.zh: : 而我不介意对世上其他所有人保密，可是……

lines.en: : I kind of...want to at least tell her that it's not really one-sided anymore.
lines.zh: : 我有点……想至少告诉她，这已经不是单方面的了。

lines.en: : That’s a bad idea, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 那是个坏主意，Ayane。

lines.en: : Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: : Because Ami would literally kill you.
lines.zh: : 因为 Ami 会 literally 杀了你。

lines.en: : She wouldn’t {i}kill{/i} me.
lines.zh: : 她不会{i}杀{/i}我的。

lines.en: : I wouldn’t be so sure of that.
lines.zh: : 我可不会那么肯定。

lines.en: scene nevermind18
: I would.
lines.zh: : 我会的。

lines.en: : We might get into little arguments and stuff, but she’s pretty much my sister.
lines.zh: : 我们也许会小吵小闹什么的，可她基本上就是我姐妹。

lines.en: : And since I obviously know everything that’s going on with her, she should probably know everything that’s going on with me as well.
lines.zh: : 而且既然我显然知道她身上发生的一切，她也该知道我身上发生的一切。

lines.en: : And that everything is you.
lines.zh: : 而那一切就是你。

lines.en: : This is a horrible idea, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 这是个糟糕透顶的主意，Ayane。

lines.en: : I’m sure it will be really awkward and confusing at first...
lines.zh: : 我确信一开始会很尴尬、很困惑……

lines.en: : But, in the long run, I think this is best for everyone.
lines.zh: : 但从长远看，我觉得这对所有人都最好。

lines.en: : I...don’t know if anything has actually {i}happened{/i} between you and Ami since you’re always so closed off and stuff...but I do know what’s happening on her side of things.
lines.zh: : 我……不知道你跟 Ami 之间是不是真{i}发生{/i}过什么，因为你总是那么封闭什么的……但我知道她那边在发生什么。

lines.en: : She’s getting very anxious and nervous with all of these new girls showing up.
lines.zh: : 随着这些新女孩一个个冒出来，她变得非常焦虑、非常紧张。

lines.en: : And I’m sure that the two of us getting closer every day doesn’t help that at all.
lines.zh: : 而我确信我们俩一天比一天亲近，对那一点帮助都没有。

lines.en: : And you think her knowing that I’m fucking her best friend will?
lines.zh: : 而你觉得她知道我在操她最好的朋友，就会有？

lines.en: scene nevermind19
: That’s not the part that’s important, Sensei. The important part is that our feelings for each other are specifically {i}more{/i} than just sex.
lines.zh: : 重要的不是那个部分，老师。重要的是我们对彼此的感情明确{i}不止{/i}于性。

lines.en: : That’s what Ami’s afraid of- you leaving her.
lines.zh: : 那才是 Ami 害怕的——你离开她。

lines.en: : It’s the same exact fear that I have.
lines.zh: : 跟我的恐惧一模一样。

lines.en: : Just...my fear has been getting a lot stronger lately.
lines.zh: : 只是……我的恐惧最近强烈多了。

lines.en: : Because of Ami?
lines.zh: : 因为 Ami？

lines.en: scene nevermind10
: Because of a few things.
lines.zh: : 因为好几件事。

lines.en: scene black
We break apart.
lines.zh: 我们分开。

lines.en: Not emotionally, but physically.
lines.zh: 不是情感上，是身体上。

lines.en: Emotionally, it’s hard to say if a strong enough bond has ever formed on my end at all.
lines.zh: 情感上，很难说我这一头到底有没有形成足够结实的羁绊。

lines.en: Let’s, in typical “me” fashion, turn this into a strange anecdotal metaphor.
lines.zh: 让我们照例，把这变成一个奇怪的轶事式比喻。

lines.en: I am a half-finished statue based on the outer layer of a real human being.
lines.zh: 我是一尊基于某个真人的外层、只完成一半的雕像。

lines.en: The process of turning me into stone is my relationship with Ayane.
lines.zh: 把我变成石头的过程，就是我和 Ayane 的关系。

lines.en: I am poised and ready for my body to be covered in a thick coat of cement.
lines.zh: 我摆好姿势，准备好让身体被厚厚一层水泥盖住。

lines.en: But the artists have only made it up to my knees before running out of whatever cement is made of.
lines.zh: 可艺术家们只浇到我的膝盖，就没了造水泥用的东西。

lines.en: Is cement even made of anything?
lines.zh: 水泥到底是用什么做的？

lines.en: Is it just cement?
lines.zh: 它就只是水泥吗？

lines.en: I don’t know.
lines.zh: 我不知道。

lines.en: I once again distract myself from anything but the topic at hand because I am afraid of thinking.
lines.zh: 我再一次用别的东西把自己从正题上岔开，因为我害怕思考。

lines.en: I am afraid of all things.
lines.zh: 我害怕一切。

lines.en: I am afraid of nothing.
lines.zh: 我什么都不怕。

lines.en: I grow wings and fly away.
lines.zh: 我长出翅膀飞走了。

lines.en: scene nevermind2
: So...umm...remember how I said I might need some more attention soon?
lines.zh: : 那么……呃……还记得我说过我可能很快就需要更多关注吗？

lines.en: : Does this meeting not qualify as that? Because you’re already kind of acting out of the ordinary here.
lines.zh: : 这次见面难道不算吗？因为你已经表现得有点反常了。

lines.en: : No. I’m talking about the...you leaving me thing.
lines.zh: : 不算。我说的是……你离开我那件事。

lines.en: : If you’re really intending to break the silence of our relationship to Ami, we should worry more about you leaving {i}me{/i}.
lines.zh: : 如果你真打算打破我们关系的沉默、告诉 Ami，我们更该担心的是你离开{i}我{/i}。

lines.en: : The things I mentioned don’t all involve Ami, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我提到的事不全跟 Ami 有关，老师。

lines.en: : Well, can we at least fully address that part first? Because I still don’t like the idea of you coming out about this.
lines.zh: : 那我们至少能把那部分先彻底谈完吗？因为我还是不喜欢你公开这件事的主意。

lines.en: scene nevermind8
: Because you’re embarrassed of me?
lines.zh: : 因为你以我为耻？

lines.en: : What? No.
lines.zh: : 什么？不是。

lines.en: : Because you don’t want to hurt Ami’s feelings?
lines.zh: : 因为你不想伤 Ami 的感情？

lines.en: : That’s closer, but still...no.
lines.zh: : 那更接近了，不过……还是不对。

lines.en: : Because you’re worried she’ll tell other people?
lines.zh: : 因为你担心她会告诉别人？

lines.en: : Ayane-
lines.zh: : Ayane——

lines.en: : Because you’re worried she’ll tell Maya?
lines.zh: : 因为你担心她会告诉 Maya？

lines.en: : What would Maya have to do with this?
lines.zh: : Maya 跟这有什么关系？

lines.en: : Remember the other day when I asked you about who you’d choose if all twenty of us were lined up in class and you were forced to pick one?
lines.zh: : 还记得前些天我问你吗——如果我们二十个人全在教室里排成一排、逼你选一个，你会选谁？

lines.en: : I remember it being a flawed hypothetical scenario based on several of the students’ attendance, but yes.
lines.zh: : 我记得那是个基于好几个学生出勤情况的、有漏洞的假设，不过对，我记得。

lines.en: : If that were true, and all of us really {i}were{/i} in the same room, I think your choice might actually surprise you.
lines.zh: : 如果那是真的，我们真全{i}在{/i}同一个房间里，我觉得你的选择大概会让你自己吃惊。

lines.en: : That’s all I’m saying.
lines.zh: : 我要说的就这些。

lines.en: : You think I’d choose Maya in that situation?
lines.zh: : 你觉得那种情形下我会选 Maya？

lines.en: : I just think you look a little differently at her than you do anyone else.
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得你看她的眼神，跟看别人不太一样。

lines.en: : I don’t know what it means, but I’d be lying if I said it doesn’t bother me.
lines.zh: : 我不知道那意味着什么，可要是说它不让我在意，那是在撒谎。

lines.en: : And that’s another one of your worries?
lines.zh: : 那是你的又一个担忧？

lines.en: : That’s another one of my worries.
lines.zh: : 那是我的又一个担忧。

lines.en: : I have a lot all of a sudden.
lines.zh: : 我突然有了好多。

lines.en: : I’m even here actually talking to you about my feelings for once because I’m so overwhelmed right now that I think I might explode.
lines.zh: : 我今晚居然真的在这儿跟你聊我的感受，就因为我这会儿快被压垮了，觉得自己可能会爆炸。

lines.en: : You should have come to my house tonight.
lines.zh: : 你今晚该来我家的。

lines.en: scene nevermind6
: I should have come to your house tonight.
lines.zh: : 我今晚该去你家的。

lines.en: : I don’t belong up here.
lines.zh: : 我不属于这儿上面。

lines.en: : I belong with everyone else...being loud and overly-expressive about the things I love most.
lines.zh: : 我属于其他所有人……大声、过分地表达我最爱的那些东西。

lines.en: scene nevermind2
: But, most of all...with you.
lines.zh: : 但最最重要的是……跟你在一起。

lines.en: : If the world really {i}was{/i} ending tonight, I’d be scared. But, in a way, I’d kind of also be a little happy.
lines.zh: : 如果世界今晚{i}真{/i}要完蛋，我会害怕。不过在某种意义上，我大概也会有点开心。

lines.en: : Maybe the world ending would just mean that it starts all over again?
lines.zh: : 也许世界完蛋只是意味着一切从头再来一次？

lines.en: : A fresh start doesn't sound bad, does it?
lines.zh: : 全新的开始听起来不坏，不是吗？

lines.en: : You'd have some of your memories back.
lines.zh: : 你会找回一些记忆。

lines.en: : I'd have both of my parents.
lines.zh: : 我会有双亲。

lines.en: : And then one day, I’d bump into Ami and meet you.
lines.zh: : 然后有一天，我会撞见 Ami、遇见你。

lines.en: : And I’d fall in love all over again.
lines.zh: : 然后我会再一次坠入爱河。

lines.en: scene nevermind5
: And then I’d catch you jerking off again.
lines.zh: : 然后我会再一次撞见你打飞机。

lines.en: : Why does that part have to come up now in the middle of a big, emotional moment?
lines.zh: : 为什么在一个情绪澎湃的大时刻里非得冒出这一段？

lines.en: scene nevermind2
: Neither of us are good at big, emotional moments.
lines.zh: : 我俩都不擅长情绪澎湃的大时刻。

lines.en: : Maybe I learned it from you, but I think it’s easier to just move onto things that aren’t painful to talk about most of the time.
lines.zh: : 也许我是跟你学的，不过我觉得大多数时候，把话题转到不痛的事情上更容易。

lines.en: : Tonight is just...a special exception.
lines.zh: : 今晚只是……一个特殊的例外。

lines.en: : I just want to know if there’s anything that can be done to make you-
lines.zh: : 我只想知道，有没有什么办法能让你——

lines.en: scene nevermind3
: Ayane again?
lines.zh: : 又是为了 Ayane？

lines.en: : Yeah.
: I see, I see.
lines.zh: : 明白了，明白了。

lines.en: : All you really have to do is love me.
lines.zh: : 你真正要做的只是爱我。

lines.en: : I can do that much.
lines.zh: : 这个我做得到。

lines.en: : And let me share those feelings with anyone that I think it’s safe to share them with.
lines.zh: : 而且让我跟任何我觉得安全的人分享那些感情。

lines.en: : That one’s a little further off, but I could probably be swayed with a few more conversations.
lines.zh: : 那条还远一点，不过再多聊几次，我大概能被说动。

lines.en: : And accept that sometimes, there will be parts of me you wish didn’t exist.
lines.zh: : 还有，接受我身上有时会有你希望不存在的部分。

lines.en: : Fine. Whatever.
lines.zh: : 行。随便。

lines.en: : And that sometimes, those parts might be hard to say out loud...so I’ll be forced to drop hint after hint after hint, hoping that you manage to understand what I’m trying to tell you.
lines.zh: : 而且有时候，那些部分可能很难说出口……所以我会不得不给一个又一个暗示，盼着你能弄明白我想告诉你什么。

lines.en: : I get it. Yeah.
lines.zh: : 我懂了。对。

lines.en: : Do you, though?
lines.zh: : 可你真的懂了吗？

lines.en: : Of course I do.
lines.zh: : 当然懂了。

lines.en: : {i}Do you, though?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你真的懂了吗？{/i}

lines.en: : Ayane...come on.
lines.zh: : Ayane……别这样。

lines.en: scene nevermind9
: Heheheh~
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿嘿～

lines.en: : It’s fine. It’s fine.
lines.zh: : 没事。没事。

lines.en: : I kind of expected things to play out like this anyway.
lines.zh: : 反正我本来就料到事情会演成这样。

lines.en: : It’s actually a pretty amazing quality being able to just effortlessly ignore the things you don’t want to acknowledge or hear.
lines.zh: : 能毫不费力地无视你不想承认或不想听见的东西，其实是一种相当了不起的本事。

lines.en: : I always have so much trouble with that.
lines.zh: : 我在这方面总是一团糟。

lines.en: : Maybe one day, far off in the future, you can teach me how to be as intentionally dense as you.
lines.zh: : 也许在很遥远的未来某天，你能教教我怎么像你一样故意迟钝。

lines.en: : Are we done talking about serious stuff and just moving onto “insult Sensei time?”
lines.zh: : 我们聊完正经事，现在进入「损老师时间」了吗？

lines.en: : Is {i}that{/i} what time it is?
lines.zh: : 现在是{i}那个{/i}时间了吗？

lines.en: : If you call it teacher time again, I’m leaving.
lines.zh: : 你要是再把它叫成「老师时间」，我就走了。

lines.en: : Already? But teacher time isn’t over yet.
lines.zh: : 这么快？可「老师时间」还没结束呢。

lines.en: scene black
: Okay. Goodnight, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 好。晚安，Ayane。

lines.en: Sensing that things are going to end here within a matter of moments, I turn around and-
lines.zh: 感觉到事情片刻之内就要在这儿结束，我转过身——

lines.en: : Wait!
lines.zh: : 等等！

lines.en: scene nevermind20
: What is it?
lines.zh: : 怎么了？

lines.en: : I don’t want you to leave yet.
lines.zh: : 我还不想让你走。

lines.en: : Then come back with me.
lines.zh: : 那就跟我回去。

lines.en: scene nevermind21
: I...don’t want to do that either.
lines.zh: : 我……也不想那么做。

lines.en: : I mean, I do...
lines.zh: : 我是说，我想……

lines.en: : But if I come back to your house, I’ll wind up telling Ami about us...and you asked for at least a few more conversations to be persuaded.
lines.zh: : 可我要是跟你回你家，我最后会告诉 Ami 我们的事……而你说过，至少还要再谈几次才肯被说服。

lines.en: : I can’t just spend the entire night here, though.
lines.zh: : 可我也不能就这么在这儿待一整晚。

lines.en: : There are other people waiting for me.
lines.zh: : 还有别的人在等我。

lines.en: scene nevermind22
: There are always other people waiting for you...
lines.zh: : 总有别的人在等你……

lines.en: : And I’m okay with that. That’s just...the effect you have, I guess.
lines.zh: : 而我接受。那大概就是……你带来的效果吧，我想。

lines.en: : It happened to me so...of course it would happen to everyone else.
lines.zh: : 它发生在我身上，所以……当然也会发生在其他人身上。

lines.en: : But right now, I...really need you to listen to me.
lines.zh: : 可现在，我……真的需要你听我说。

lines.en: : Sensei..
lines.zh: : 老师……

lines.en: : Something...
lines.zh: : 有件事……

lines.en: : Something happened and...
lines.zh: : 发生了一件事，而且……

lines.en: : And it's something I really need your help with and...
lines.zh: : 而且那件事我真的需要你帮忙，而且……

lines.en: : I’m listening, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 我在听，Ayane。

lines.en: : Whatever it is, I’m sure it won’t change anything between us.
lines.zh: : 不管是什么，我确信它不会改变我们之间的任何东西。

lines.en: : So, if that’s what you’re worried about-
lines.zh: : 所以，如果你担心的是那个——

lines.en: scene nevermind23
: Nevermind.
lines.zh: : 算了。

lines.en: : ...What?
: Nevermind.
lines.zh: : 算了。

lines.en: : Don’t worry about it.
lines.zh: : 别担心。

lines.en: : I can tell you some other time.
lines.zh: : 我可以改天再告诉你。

lines.en: : Just tell me now. If there’s more to the reason you called me out here-
lines.zh: : 现在就说吧。如果你叫我出来还有别的原因——

lines.en: scene nevermind24
: I just wanted to look at the sky with you.
lines.zh: : 我只是想跟你一起看天空。

lines.en: : That’s all.
lines.zh: : 就这样。

lines.en: : I’ll stop telling everyone I’m not feeling well for real this time.
lines.zh: : 这次我真的不会再跟所有人说我不舒服了。

lines.en: : And I’ll...keep doing my best.
lines.zh: : 而我会……继续尽力。

lines.en: : Just...try to be there for me if I need you...
lines.zh: : 只是……我需要你的时候，尽量在就好……

lines.en: scene nevermind25
: Okay?
lines.zh: : 好吗？

lines.en: : I love you...
lines.zh: : 我爱你……

lines.en: : So...so much...
lines.zh: : 那么……那么深……

lines.en: : Ayane-
lines.zh: : Ayane——

lines.en: : I’ll head home in a little while. I promise.
lines.zh: : 我一会儿就回家。我保证。

lines.en: : I just want to be alone for a few minutes.
lines.zh: : 我只是想一个人待几分钟。

lines.en: : Okay.
: I love you too.
lines.zh: : 我也爱你。

lines.en: scene black
My wings retreat back into my flesh and I’m forced to walk down several flights of stairs with the image of a crying blonde girl etched into my mind.
lines.zh: 我的翅膀缩回肉里，我被迫走下好几层楼梯，脑子里刻着一个金发女孩哭泣的画面。

lines.en: I don’t know what it is Ayane was about to tell me at the end...
lines.zh: 我不知道 Ayane 最后到底要告诉我什么……

lines.en: But I’m sure that it will come up again in due time.
lines.zh: 不过我确信那事迟早会再冒出来。

lines.en: Either that or I’m just once again being “intentionally dense” or whatever it is she called me.
lines.zh: 要么就是我又一次只是「故意迟钝」，或者随便她怎么称呼的那个。

lines.en: That doesn’t sound too far off.
lines.zh: 那听起来也不算离谱。

lines.en: I hope she’s okay, though.
lines.zh: 不过我希望她没事。

lines.en: I really do.
lines.zh: 我是真希望。

lines.en: Just not enough to drop everything and be with her regardless of her plea for privacy.
lines.zh: 只是还没到能放下一切、不顾她要隐私的请求也要陪着她的程度。

lines.en: Perhaps one day I’ll get there.
lines.zh: 也许有一天我会到那儿。

lines.en: But for now-
lines.zh: 不过现在——

lines.en: I slide my hands into my pockets for the millionth time and go back home.
lines.zh: 我第一百万次把手插进口袋，回家去了。

lines.zh: {i}Ayane 的好感度提升到了 [ayane_love]！{/i}
